}}'''Satina''' is a serving woman at the Little Tower in [[Salidar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Satina}} She is plump. She shares a room with [[Mulinda]], [[Emara]] and [[Ronelle]].

==Activities==
When a bubble of evil hits Salidar, [[Nynaeve]] calls her to help removing a blanket from around Emara and Ronelle's throats.
